Default Title - $165.00 USD Quantity Add to Cart     NOTE: This is a fully built fuzz, not the kit. You will be able to pull this out off the box and play it. no assembly required. LARAN is the first DIY kit from Gorva Design. Made in collaboration with Mask Audio Electronics of Pittsburgh. A full-bodied fuzz packed with top-of-the-line Gorva audiophile components. It tears down the common muff and rebuilds it to be bigger and meaner. A MOSFET input stage slams two additional clipping stages for an effect that can add up to a mild, crisp overdrive to full on “Make amp go BRRRRRRRR” fuzz.
